name: Cliff Jonesy
source:
Job: Attorney

Cliff's a novice surfer who likes to hit the waves early and avoid morning rush hour traffic...and embarrassment.

He's kind and a little squeamish, but he's always looking for a surf tip or two.

[From [url=https://soulsoftea.itch.io/baraboarders]itch.io[/url]]
